generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Create opportunity cards, decision records, trade-off matrices, and recommendation packets for decision-making.

contract.purpose_user_function: Create decision records, opportunity cards, trade-off matrices, and recommendation packets from evidence.
contract.valid_inputs: Problem/opportunity, alternatives, criteria, evidence, risks, feasibility/impact, stakeholders, and decision status.
contract.expected_outputs: Structured decision/opportunity artifact with alternatives, rationale, evidence links, risks, and next action.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes markdown/JSON/report artifacts; should not execute the chosen action automatically.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing alternatives/evidence, unsupported recommendation, hidden trade-off, or policy conflict yields inconclusive/review-required artifact.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Research/ideation/report skills can produce these artifacts; no single canonical decision-artifact constructor/schema was found.
contract.success_evidence: Recommendation traces to explicit criteria/evidence and records limitations and unresolved review items.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: opportunity; alternatives; criteria scoring; evidence gap; recommendation; human review; revision.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow and Appendix AutoSci Commands; docs/WORKFLOW_DESIGN.md Phases 2-5; AGENTS.md Scope and Local Workflow
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Solar ships primarily as a Claude Code overlay. Concrete builds depend on selected physical operators, language toolchains, credentials, datasets, hardware, and approval/write-scope policy.

implementation.interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
